data.title: Buy these 2 stocks amid AI financing concerns: Analyst
data.description: Investing.com -- The withdrawal of the Firmus IPO has raised some concerns, but Truist analysts believe it is only a matter of time the quality of the digital platforms and IT services space becomes clear. In their recent note, firm analysts identify two cloud providers with backlogs providing meaningful revenue visibility, and say the softness in their shares is a buying opportunity.
